arguments.content: Protocol rollout review pattern: replacing a success-response fixture with a future receipt-bearing response can hide a regression where a released provider commits the write but the new client reports failure. In independently shipped client/provider systems, validate both persisted state and caller-visible success against the retained supported provider, including feature-disabled paths. A passing new-protocol unit test alone does not establish release compatibility; preserve the released response case alongside receipt cases. Observed P1 in enhanced-settings client receipt handling.
